Hi all,

I am Madhura from India, working on large carnivores in a Central Indian dry deciduous forest.

I recently analyzed my transect data using DSM and followed most of the codes from "http://distancesampling.org/R/vignettes/mexico-analysis.html"..

I could run the whole analysis successfully and I am stuck at the step of plotting abundance over prediction grid.
I used ggplot2 and maptools too and could plot all the plots mentioned in the example analysis except this one.
I am constantly getting this error -

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'x' not found

Rest whole script is correctly run.
Please help out.

Thank you
